title: Nvidia Board Reportedly Moves to Oust CEO Jensen Huang
dek: A second alleged affair surfaced days after he admitted to the first.

facts.label: Huang admits infidelity in staff memo
Deadline for House GOP closed briefing

caption:
The man who built the world's biggest AI chip company could be out within days. ⚠️

The Wall Street Journal reports that Nvidia's board is preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang, citing people familiar with the matter. This comes after a second alleged affair, reportedly with a direct report, surfaced just days after Huang admitted infidelity in a November 8 staff memo. US officials reportedly believe the woman in the first affair was a Chinese intelligence asset, a claim China denies and which remains unproven.

Nothing is official yet. Nvidia hasn't announced a decision, and an independent investigation led by former US attorney Joon H. Kim is still underway. Still, Nvidia shares fell roughly 8% after hours as the reports broke.

Why it matters: Huang co-founded Nvidia in 1993 and turned it into the backbone of the AI boom. A leadership change would ripple through the entire AI industry. We're tracking every update at AI Parabellum.
